company.name: Physical Intelligence (π)
company.source_note:
Physical Intelligence builds general-purpose robot foundation models via Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architecture. Core model π0 (open-sourced Feb 2024) processes visual inputs + natural language commands and executes physical actions. π0.7 released April 2026 as a steerable model with emergent capabilities. Revenue model includes foundation-model 'brains' capturing double-digit take-rate of robot ASPs via APIs, licensing, and vertical bundles. Targets industrial/commercial general-purpose robotics.
Total ~$1.1B funded; $70M Seed (~$400M val) + $400M Series A (~$2B val) + $600M Series B (~$5.6B val); investors include CapitalG, Sequoia, Khosla, Bond, Redpoint, Jeff Bezos, OpenAI, Thrive Capital, Lux Capital
Founded 2024 by ex-DeepMind & Berkeley researchers; emerged from stealth March 2024; ongoing research output (π0 → π0.5 → π0.6 → π0.7 milestone chain)

outreach_drafts.body:
ATTORNEY REVIEW ONLY — DO NOT SEND/POST.
Target: Karol Hausman
Public fact hook / hypothesis: Physical Intelligence just released π0.7 and raised $600M at $5.6B — the convergence of massive capital, latest model milestone, and foundational AI technology makes this the ideal window for AI Patent Strategy engagement. Their cross-embodiment learning paradigm (models transferring skills across different robotic hardware) is inherently novel and likely generating significant patentable inventions. With a revenue model based on foundation-model brains via APIs/licensing, IP position is directly tied to revenue feasibility. The founding team's academic pedigree (DeepMind, Berkeley, Stanford) suggests they value rigorous IP strategy.
Suggested lead magnet: AI Patent Strategy Scorecard — /ai-patent-strategy-scorecard
LinkedIn awareness draft exists for internal review only; do not post, tag, or trigger workflows without exact approval.

Internal LinkedIn awareness draft:
$600 million new round. π0.7 released. $1.1 billion total.

When a company built by ex-DeepMind researchers crosses $1B funding to build general-purpose AI for robots, a different invention question emerges:

If foundation models learn to control any robot, do robot makers still need their own patents — or do they license from the model layer?

Cross-embodiment learning means skills transfer across hardware. Open-sourcing π0 means the weights are available to anyone. The companies that will survive are the ones planning their IP strategy NOW:

For #founders: your model architecture IS your patent strategy. Document before you demo.
For #robotics-engineers: cross-embodiment innovation is inherently defensible — but only if the human contribution is clear.
For #investors: valuation depends on IP ownership of the brain layer, not just the hardware.

Educational starting point: AI Patent Strategy Scorecard
https://whiteford-ai-law-pages.vercel.app/ai-patent-strategy-scorecard

Guardrail: no outreach, email/SMS, workflow enrollment, trigger tags, LinkedIn/social action, Clio writes, public/client-facing changes, or live CRM/Supabase sync without Jeff exact approval.
